body_markdown:
ORLANDO, FL (Feb 5, 2026) — Massimo showcased its second-generation MVR HVAC Pro Series at the 2026 Golf Course Superintendents Association of America (GCSAA) Conference and Trade Show, February 2 to 5 in Orlando, Florida.


Two models were on display:


- **MVR HVAC Pro Golf:** built for golf course operations and hospitality.
- **MVR HVAC Pro Cargo Max:** a utility platform for fleet, maintenance and commercial work.


Both feature factory-integrated heating and air conditioning in a fully enclosed cab, for year-round, all-weather use in professional settings.


GCSAA followed three industry events already attended in 2026: AIMExpo in California, the PGA Show in Orlando and the Mid-States Rendezvous. Together these events have produced more than 100 dealer leads.


"Each industry event we attend further validates our strategy of targeting fleet buyers and professional users with premium, climate-controlled electric vehicles," said David Shan, then CEO of Massimo Group.
